title: usenet-ipfs-mail: Email write path
description:
Implement JMAP Email/set create (compose and post an article): validate JMAP Email submission, sign with operator key, write to IPFS, append to group log via the core POST pipeline. Email/set destroy returns unsupportedOperation (articles are immutable in v1).

Why: JMAP clients expect to be able to send messages; reusing the core POST pipeline avoids duplicating signing and storage logic.

How to apply: depends on Email read path for object type, depends on usenet-ipfs-core POST pipeline.
